name: Nagyváty (Hungary)
description: White field with a central horizontal stripe of yellow bordered in blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagyváty (a red and blue shield with a yellow eagle and a red cross) above a white scroll inscribed NAGYVÁTY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
